user.title: Add battery
user.description: Found {count} battery/batteries with a state of charge and a DC battery power sensor. Pick one, or choose the sensors yourself. Maximum {max} batteries.

specs.title: Factory data and warranty
specs.description: Defaults are the Marstek Venus E 5.12 kWh datasheet (DoD 90 %, > 6000 cycles, 80 % after 6000 cycles). Marstek gives no capacity guarantee in years.

data_description.nominal_kwh: Total capacity of the cells, e.g. 5.12 kWh.
data_description.reserve_kwh: Part of the nominal capacity the battery never releases. Datasheet: 90 % DoD, so 5.12 − 0.51 = 4.61 kWh = 100 % of new.
data_description.cycle_eol_pct: Manufacturer spec: e.g. 80 % after 6000 cycles (Marstek, Venus E Gen 3.0 product page). This is the spec line; not a warranty.
data_description.initial_cycles: Estimate: total discharged kWh so far divided by the usable capacity. Leave 0 for a new battery.
data_description.red_pct: At or below this % remaining the status turns red: the moment to report it to Marstek via the Marstek app. Default 75 %.
data_description.tolerance_pct: Green while the measurement is at most this many points below the manufacturer spec line. Default 5.

details.title: Battery and sensors
details.description: Check the proposal. The power sensor must measure the battery (DC) side, not the AC / grid side. Whether charging is positive or negative is detected automatically.

data_description.battery_id: Used in entity ids, e.g. mt1 gives sensor.marstek_mt1_capacity_pct. Lowercase letters, digits and _.
data_description.power_entity: Power measured on the battery (DC) side. W or kW.

error.same_entity: SOC and power must be different sensors.
error.reserve_too_large: The reserve must be smaller than the nominal capacity.
error.looks_like_ac: This sensor looks like the AC / grid side, not the battery (DC) side. AC values include conversion losses and give a wrong capacity. Choose the battery power sensor, or submit again to use this one anyway.

abort.already_configured: This battery id is already in use.
abort.max_batteries: The maximum of 6 batteries has been reached.

reset_measurements.description: Forget all measurements of one battery. Cannot be undone.
